svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: PostgreSQL StatefulSet with CSI storage and backups
svg.desc: PostgreSQL StatefulSet with CSI storage and backups. 15 components in 5 groups. Connections: orders-api to Headless Service (postgres-0.postgres); Headless Service to postgres-0; Headless Service to postgres-1; Headless Service to postgres-2; postgres-0 to data-postgres-0; postgres-1 to data-postgres-1; postgres-2 to data-postgres-2; data-postgres-0 to PersistentVolume (bound); data-postgres-1 to PersistentVolume; data-postgres-2 to PersistentVolume; StatefulSet postgres to StorageClass; StorageClass to Longhorn CSI driver (provisioner); Longhorn CSI driver to PersistentVolumes; Namespace orders to Velero (nightly backup); Velero to Object storage.

text.tspan: POSTGRESQL STATEFULSET WITH CSI STORAGE AND BACKUPS
A headless Service gives each replica a stable name, each pod claims its own volume from the Longhorn CSI driver, and Velero backs it all up
